test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 6 March 2023)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

# : KNF :: QCV : %
solution:
The position of the English alphabet is given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

The logic followed here is :- 

 
• First letter → (2) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Second letter → (2) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Third letter → (2) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.

​So,

**Option 1) **# = IPD, % = OET ⇒ IPD : KNF :: QCV : OET

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9bdf322ab6b73d4857c3e463a7eb1eeac2023144999611ff0b90c837a8a6eba.png] 

Does not follow the same pattern = Incorrect

**Option 2) **# = HPD, % = NFS ⇒ HPD : KNF :: QCV : NFS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/226cde250816e1a121b78d244e150e9ff4aa3ede55b3eef6dc43b11184ca5237.png] 

Does not follow the same pattern = Incorrect

**Option 3) **# = MLH, % = OET ⇒ MLH : KNF :: QCV : OET

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e45190c6856c12c43e28ca796c9ba65c9afcb7066946226ace7b01c9c8acbcab.png] 

**Follow the same pattern = Correct**

**Option 4) **# = HQC, % = NFS ⇒ HQC : KNF :: QCV : NFS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0a7d83a5a581ad1b225664888bd782b3db6fc8116659fe9479c569f31984e86.png] 

Does not follow the same pattern = Incorrect

Hence, the correct answer is **"# = MLH, % = OET".**
